blockers.requirement: Focus candidate o-612ad39b3027076e: the uncompress target must be able to complete a valid zlib stream whose decompressed output exceeds 65,025 bytes.
blockers.failure_condition: A finite valid zlib stream with a final stored block producing 65,026 bytes exceeds every capacity the entry can allocate. tinfl_decompress reports that output space is exhausted; the first-call MZ_FINISH path returns MZ_BUF_ERROR, and mz_uncompress2 cannot return success.
